title: Lattice motion manifest
description: A shipped motion PACKAGE (engineering/decisions/2026-09-23-portable-packages.md §3.3, §5). The manifest owns the name and the Library card's text; the sibling <name>.scene.json is the Anima scene, <name>.poster.svg the still a PDF freezes, and <name>.art.svg the drawing an `svg` scene animates. A deck never names a motion package: the Studio's Insert copies the poster and the scene into the deck, so removing a package never breaks a deck. tools/build-packages-index.js generates lib/motion/scenes.generated.js, the list the Studio's Library reads, from these files.

name.description: The package name. MUST equal the folder name and every file prefix (checkPackageIdentity).

label.description: The Library card's title, and the heading Insert writes on the slide.

description.description: One sentence: what moves. Insert writes it into the poster's <desc>, so it is what a screen reader says.

engine.description: Which library plays the scene: `zdog` for a `built` scene, `anime` for an `svg` one. The Studio's export writes the same field.

order.description: Position in the Library's shipped list. Unique across motion packages.
